statement: A path with a percent-escape that does not decode (`%zz`, `%2`, a trailing `%`), or with a dot segment after one decoding, in any encoding (including after removing path parameters, with an encoded ';' and with '\' as a separator), or longer than 2048 characters as received, or with a segment longer than 256 UTF-16 units once decoded (after removing path parameters), is answered 400 before authentication. A segment longer than 256 characters only encoded is refused for every other reason a shorter one is. A pattern that matches the path as received (decodeAndParseSegments: false) reads each segment as written, so it matches no path with a segment longer than 256 characters as written.
guards: engine:HttpPathPatternTest#a pattern that matches the path as received matches no segment longer than the bound as written
